tools.name: pulse-setup-integration
tools.description: START HERE — Call this tool before generating any Pulse integration code. It returns a tailored plan listing exactly which tools to implement and which to skip, based on your vertical, integration method, and business rules.

vertical.description: Your industry vertical. Options: hospitality, airlines, transportation, ticketing, mass-participation, tours-activities, otas, payment-provider

integrationMethod.description: How you will integrate Pulse: 'widget' (JavaScript snippet for any web platform), 'react' (React component library), 'api' (direct HTTP calls in any language)

allowPostPurchaseUpdates.description: Whether your platform allows updating bookings after purchase (e.g. change value, event date, or products)

allowCancellations.description: Whether your platform allows customers to cancel bookings

tools.name: pulse-widget-installation
tools.description: Install Pulse javascript widget, this should be created once in the source code. Insert the code returned as an script

tools.name: pulse-widget-render
tools.description: This is the code to render the Pulse javascript widget once its installed. Add the div with pgr-payment-container and call updateQuoteData action.

TotalValue.description: The total value of the booking

EventTravelDateTime.description: Event travel date time in ISO format

tools.name: pulse-widget-write-sale
tools.description: JavaScript code to submit a sale via the Pulse Widget writeSale action. Call this after the customer confirms payment.

tools.name: pulse-widget-change-locale
tools.description: JavaScript code to change the language and/or currency of the Pulse Widget at runtime, for example when a customer switches language or currency on your site.

tools.name: pulse-widget-confirmation-email
tools.description: Generate the Refundable Booking confirmation HTML to include in the booking confirmation email sent to the customer. Only required for the Refund Protect product.

vendorCode.description: Your vendor code or client ID (supplied by ProtectGroup commercial team)

tools.name: pulse-react-installation
tools.description: Install pulse react NPM script and configure RefundableProvider at the root level of the project using RefundableOptions below wrapper to provide context to all child components and TheRestOfYourApp is the existing app component

tools.name: pulse-react-content-render
tools.description: Place the RefundableContent and ProductContent components in your checkout page. RefundableContent should go on the payment page. ProductContent (only if offering a Pulse product) should go on the extras/pre-payment page.

tools.name: pulse-react-update-quote
tools.description: React code to update quote data when internal state changes in your application. Supports simple (totalValue + numberOfTickets) and multi-price (values[]) formats.

tools.name: pulse-react-sale
tools.description: React code to write, update and cancel a sale using writeSale, patchSale and cancelSale from useRefundableActions hook

tools.name: pulse-react-confirmation-email
tools.description: Generate the Refundable Booking confirmation HTML to include in the booking confirmation email sent to the customer. Only required for the Refund Protect product.

vendorCode.description: Your vendor code or client ID (supplied by ProtectGroup commercial team)

tools.name: pulse-api-content-placement
tools.description: Explains how to render the product HTML returned by the Pulse quote API response, place it in the correct stage of the checkout (Journey vs Payment), and listen to the pg-change event to track product selection.

tools.name: pulse-api-confirmation-email
tools.description: Generate the Refundable Booking confirmation HTML to include in the booking confirmation email sent to the customer. Only required for the Refund Protect product. The customerServiceEmail field in the sale request can populate the email address placeholder dynamically.

vendorCode.description: Your vendor code or client ID (supplied by ProtectGroup commercial team)
